description: This file 'usp_log.c' contains logging functions for debug printing, callstack tracing, buffer hex dump, SSL error logging, and log level management within a C project. It manages logging output to files, syslog, or stdout, and includes mechanisms for protocol tracing and vendor hook callbacks.

methods.name: USP_LOG_SetFile
methods.description: Sets the log output to a specified file, stdout, or syslog.

methods.name: USP_LOG_Callstack
methods.description: Prints the current callstack if execinfo.h is available.

methods.name: USP_LOG_HexBuffer
methods.description: Logs the contents of a buffer in hex format.

methods.name: USP_LOG_ErrorSSL
methods.description: Logs SSL error details (conditional on REMOVE_DEVICE_SECURITY).

methods.name: USP_LOG_String
methods.description: Logs a string, splitting on newlines.

methods.name: USP_LOG_Printf
methods.description: Logs a formatted message with variable arguments.

methods.name: USP_LOG_Puts
methods.description: Logs a message to the appropriate destination based on log type.

methods.name: LogLevelToSyslogSeverity
methods.description: Converts internal log level to syslog severity.

methods.name: LogMessageToFile
methods.description: Outputs a log message to a file or syslog, and invokes vendor callback.

methods.name: CloseLog
methods.description: Closes the log file if it is a file on disk.

methods.name: USP_SNPRINTF
methods.description: Safe snprintf that always null-terminates and returns the length.
